primary_source.title: Sliding Windows and Persistence: An Application of Topological Methods to Signal Analysis
primary_source.claim_boundary: The source studies persistent homology of sliding-window/time-delay point clouds and links maximum persistence to periodicity. v16 uses only fixed causal 0-dimensional Vietoris-Rips death times, exactly represented by MST edge weights; it is not SW1PerS/H1 and makes no source-derived P1 performance claim.

deep_research_gap_matrix.A_delay_embedding_persistence: SELECTED: no P1 implementation or execution; multi-scale component-merger geometry differs from fixed-radius recurrence and endpoint visibility.
deep_research_gap_matrix.B_empirical_tail_copula: REJECT_SEMANTIC_OVERLAP: nonlinear extremal dependence is distinct mathematically but its P1 action fingerprint is another prefix-fitted cross-layer dependence-change score, overlapping v9 conditional dependence and v12 distribution shift.
deep_research_gap_matrix.C_supervised_shapelet: REJECT_SEMANTIC_OVERLAP: discriminative subsequence morphology overlaps executed causal CIF, MiniRocket, and v14 nearest-subsequence dictionary families.
deep_research_gap_matrix.transport_risk: The prospective v13 station-layer x chronological-half veto remains fixed; pooled inner LCB alone cannot select a threshold.
deep_research_gap_matrix.limitation: 0D persistence records connected-component merger scales, not the H1 periodicity score in Perea-Harer. Fixed dimension/window/stride are a bounded falsification, not an optimized topology pipeline.

semantic_audit.v10_recurrence: fixed lag/radius scalar recurrence and laminar duration; v16 instead summarizes the full pairwise geometry of a causal delay-embedding cloud across all merger scales
semantic_audit.v13_visibility: order-obstruction graph from one endpoint; v16 is metric topology of a multi-point delay cloud and has no visibility edge rule
semantic_audit.v9_v12: conditional covariance/precision change and RBF-MMD recent-vs-prefix distribution shift; v16 is within-window temporal state-space shape, not cross-layer dependence or two-sample discrepancy
semantic_audit.cif_minirocket_v14_shapelet: interval/convolution and nearest-template morphology; v16 has no learned shapelet, random interval, kernel bank, or dictionary nearest-neighbor

representation.normalization: single prefix-fitted robust station-layer center and scale
